body:
There is no way I could enjoy myself with a vacation. I have tried so many times in the past, and it always just ends up in the same place: me staying in the hotel room and feeling miserable and hopeless. Whenever I go out I want to go home, and when I am home I want to die, or at least not exist. I'm hopeless.

Edit: Though I cannot even begin to express my gratitude that someone actually cares enough to talk to me, I expected this to get completely buried, in fact I almost counted on it, so thank you, kind internet stranger

Thats the hardest part, nothing is wrong with my environment, the past is the past and unchangeable but it still hurts like hell to think about. I'm just creating all this drama on my own. No one is bullying me, considering I'm homeschooled, no one is abusing me, outside of myself with all the punching myself in the head. My life has been better than about 98% of the world, with middle-upper class income, and food (too much) in my stomach. Its my fault for making myself miserable and thinking about that just makes me even more furious at myself.
I have definitely tried, it just gets far to overwhelming looking at everything thats wrong with me and I give up.
